modelspec.training.MuonConfig.title: MuonConfig
modelspec.training.MuonConfig.description: The hyperparameters of a Muon run besides those it shares with AdamW, settled by coordinator decision D67 of 2026-10-25 (DESIGN.md § 2.1). A matrix parameter no embedding reads takes the Muon update at OptimizerConfig.learning_rate; every other parameter takes AdamW at adam_learning_rate with the betas and epsilon of OptimizerConfig; both share its weight decay and schedule. The momentum buffer of each Muon parameter is not checkpointed, so a Muon run is neither checkpointed nor resumed.

momentum.description: The momentum of the Nesterov buffer, in [0, 1).

ns_steps.description: The Newton-Schulz steps that orthogonalize each update, in [1, 10].

adam_learning_rate.description: The peak learning rate of the parameters AdamW updates.
